elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项在线调查整合了离散选择实验(DCE)和跨期选择任务,用于量化属性偏好、货币贴现率和影响父母决策的因素。该研究将 队列研究 分为接受的大多数 (79.4%) 和犹豫的少数 (20.6%)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用混合 Logit 模型估计主要属性偏好,而潜在类别分析则确定偏好异质性。交互项被用来检查跨期偏好如何调节这些选择。
elements_zh.main_results: 经验数据显示,保护期限和 疫苗 有效性是父母选择的主要决定因素,而表明医疗保健专业人员的孩子已接种疫苗的社会参考信息也很重要。较高的货币贴现率与接受多数的成员资格有关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 父母对 HPV 疫苗接种 的选择反映了临床属性、社会参考信息和跨期偏好。保护期限和 疫苗 的有效性最重要,当父母被告知医疗保健专业人员的孩子已经接种疫苗时,他们更经常选择 疫苗接种。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 降低自付费用和传达可信的社会参考信息作为干预策略值得测试。鉴于样本主要是城市和受过高等教育的人,这些研究结果应谨慎推广。

title_zh: 跨期偏好和社会信号如何驱动父母的选择? 人乳头瘤病毒 疫苗接种 上的离散选择实验
source_body_en: Parental vaccine hesitancy constrains human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccination uptake. However, how intertemporal preferences and social signals relate to this hesitancy remains underexplored. An online survey integrating a discrete choice experiment (DCE) and an intertemporal choice task was deployed to quantify attribute preferences, monetary discount rates, and the factors shaping parental decisions. Primary attribute preferences were estimated using a mixed logit model, while latent class analysis identified preference heterogeneity. Additionally, interaction terms were utilized to examine how intertemporal preferences modulate these choices. Empirical data reveal that protection duration and vaccine effectiveness were the primary determinants of parental choice, while social-reference information indicating that healthcare professionals’ children had been vaccinated was also valued. Vaccine origin showed no significant effect. Latent class analysis segmented the cohort into a receptive majority (79.4%) and a hesitant minority (20.6%). Interaction models indicated that monetary discounting was jointly associated with the structure of preferences, although no individual attribute interaction survived adjustment for multiple testing. Parental choices about HPV vaccination reflected clinical attributes, social reference information, and intertemporal preferences. Protection duration and vaccine effectiveness mattered most, and parents more often chose vaccination when told that healthcare professionals’ children had been vaccinated. Higher monetary discount rates were associated with membership in the receptive majority, although the attribute-level interactions were exploratory after adjustment for multiple testing. Reducing out-of-pocket costs and communicating credible social-reference information are worth testing as intervention strategies. Given the predominantly urban and highly educated sample, these findings should be generalized with caution.
abstract_zh: 父母对 疫苗 的犹豫限制了 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗接种 的吸收。然而,跨期偏好和社会信号与这种犹豫之间的关系仍有待探索。一项在线调查整合了离散选择实验(DCE)和跨期选择任务,用于量化属性偏好、货币贴现率和影响父母决策的因素。使用混合 Logit 模型估计主要属性偏好,而潜在类别分析则确定偏好异质性。此外,还利用交互项来研究跨期偏好如何调节这些选择。经验数据显示,保护期限和 疫苗 有效性是父母选择的主要决定因素,而表明医疗保健专业人员的孩子已接种疫苗的社会参考信息也很重要。疫苗 起源没有表现出明显的影响。潜在类别分析将 队列研究 分为接受的大多数 (79.4%) 和犹豫的少数 (20.6%)。交互模型表明,货币贴现与偏好结构共同相关,尽管没有个体属性交互能够在多重测试的调整中幸存下来。父母对 HPV 疫苗接种 的选择反映了临床属性、社会参考信息和跨期偏好。保护期限和 疫苗 的有效性最重要,当父母被告知医疗保健专业人员的孩子已经接种疫苗时,他们更经常选择 疫苗接种。较高的货币贴现率与接受多数的成员资格相关,尽管在多次测试调整后属性级别的相互作用是探索性的。降低自付费用和传达可信的社会参考信息作为干预策略值得测试。鉴于样本主要是城市和受过高等教育的人,这些研究结果应谨慎推广。

title: Patterns, distributions and predictors of human papillomavirus vaccination coverage among girls across 31 African countries
abstract: Cervical cancer is a leading cause of cancer-related deaths among women in sub-Saharan Africa, with Africa accounting for approximately 23% of global cervical cancer mortality. Despite the proven efficacy of human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines in the prevention of cervical cancer, coverage remains far below the 90% global target. This study assessed HPV vaccination trends, regional differences, and the effect of vaccination programme duration on HPV vaccination coverage among girls and young women in Africa. Country data on HPV immunisation were obtained from the World Health Organization Immunization Portal. Descriptive statistics were used to estimate mean coverage (standard deviation), variation, and regional distribution in percentages. Linear regression analyses examined the association of HPV immunisation programme duration with vaccination coverage. By 2024, only 31 of 54 (56%) African countries had integrated HPV vaccination into their routine immunisation schedules, mostly targeting girls aged 9–14 years. The mean first-dose and last-dose coverage across the 31 countries were 64% (SD: 25.4) and 55% (SD: 27.3) respectively. The lowest coverage rates for the first and last doses were in Mali (15%), Gambia (15%) and Morocco (3%), whereas Cape Verde, Burkina Faso, Uganda, United Republic of Tanzania, and Mauritius achieved over 90% for both doses. Regionally, first and last-dose coverage were 77% and 61% in Eastern and Southern Africa, 63% and 60% in West and Central Africa, and 52% and 27% in North Africa, respectively. Across the 31 countries, HPV immunisation programme duration was positively associated with first-dose coverage (coefficient = 2.97, 95% CI: 0.28–5.66, p = 0.032), with each additional year of the programme associated with a 3% increase in vaccination coverage. In 2022, second-dose coverage was significantly associated with both programme duration (β = 4.192, SE = 1.278, 95% CI: 1.53–6.85, p = 0.004) and first-dose vaccination coverage (β = 0.321, SE = 0.133, 95% CI: 0.04–0.59, p = 0.025). HPV vaccination coverage in Africa is increasing slowly but remains below the target. However, longer programme duration is associated with higher uptake, highlighting the need for sustained investment and strengthened programme delivery to meet global vaccination targets.

title: Is Endocervical Curettage (ECC) Necessary for All HPV16/18-Positive Patients? A Stratified Analysis of 670 Cases
abstract: Background: High-risk HPV16/18 subtypes account for over 70% of cervical cancers, but should all HPV16/18-positive patients routinely undergo endocervical curettage (ECC)? Methods: A retrospective cohort study was conducted on 670 HPV16/18-positive patients who underwent colposcopy at Peking University People’s Hospital from 2021 to 2024. Stratified analysis was performed based on prior HPV infection history, current cervical cytology and HPV test results, transformation zone (TZ) type, and colposcopic impression. Primary outcome was the detection rate of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia above (CIN2)+ on final pathology and the additional diagnostic yield of ECC in the ECC subgroup. Results: Among the 670 HPV16/18-positive women, CIN2+ was identified in 32.5% (218/670); the CIN2+ group was significantly younger than the < CIN2 group (median 36.5 vs. 41.0 years, p < 0.001). A high-grade colposcopic impression (G2) steeply elevated the observed CIN2+ proportion to 100%, especially combined with high-grade cytology. In contrast, a Normal/G1 colposcopic finding effectively downgraded the risk to 4.8% in the presence of prior HPV negativity + low-grade cytology + visible TZ. Among the 523 ECC specimens, it is noteworthy that even when the final pathology was diagnosed as CIN2+, a considerably high proportion of patients (44.4–64.7%) remained free of lesions in the endocervical canal; in the colposcopy impression (G2) population, 68.1% of the ECC was normal. The incremental yield of ECC over directed biopsy was only 2.7% (14/523), and all 14 incremental cases occurred in TZ3 (100%). Among the 146 women meeting the composite low-risk profile (TZ1/2 combined with a Normal/G1 colposcopic impression), none had an incremental CIN2+ detection. Conclusion: Women with HPV16/18-positive CIN2+ lesions presented at a younger age. Approximately one-third were diagnosed with CIN2+, and more than half of these had normal ECC histology. With a low additional diagnostic rate observed, ECC provided incremental diagnostic benefit in only 2.7% of HPV16/18-positive women undergoing colposcopy, almost exclusively among patients with a Type 3 transformation zone. The composite low-risk profile identified a subgroup with an extremely low additional diagnostic yield of ECC; however, prospective validation is required before the omission of ECC in this subgroup can be recommended as a change in clinical practice.

A retrospective cohort of 670 patients underwent colposcopy at Peking University People’s Hospital between 2021 and 2024. title: Epidemiological characteristics and genotype distribution of human papillomavirus infection among 39,335 women in Gaochun District, Nanjing, China
abstract: To characterize HPV positivity, age-specific distribution, infection patterns, genotype distribution, and annual variations in HPV positivity among women undergoing HPV testing at a hospital in Gaochun District, Nanjing, China, and to provide local baseline data for regional HPV surveillance and cervical cancer prevention and control research. This single-center retrospective cross-sectional study included women who underwent HPV testing at Gaochun People’s Hospital of Nanjing between January 2017 and September 2024. For women with multiple HPV testing records during the study period, only the first test result was retained. HPV positivity, risk-category distribution, infection patterns, and genotype distribution were analyzed by age group. Annual HPV positivity rates were summarized descriptively for 2017–2024. The 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for HPV positivity rates were calculated using the Wilson method. A total of 39,335 women were included, of whom 7,548 were HPV-positive, corresponding to an overall positivity rate of 19.2% (95% CI, 18.8%–19.6%). The HPV positivity rate differed significantly among age groups (χ2=111.104, P < 0.001). The highest positivity rate was observed in women aged 0–19 years, at 44.2% (42/95), followed by those aged 60–69 years, at 26.0% (356/1,368); the lowest rate was observed in women aged 30–39 years, at 17.3% (1,984/11,484). Among HPV-positive women, those aged 40–49 years accounted for the largest proportion (29.2%). Single-type infection was identified in 5,412 women, accounting for 71.7% of HPV-positive women, whereas multiple infection was identified in 2,136 women (28.3%); double, triple, and ≥ 4-type infections accounted for 19.6%, 5.9%, and 2.8%, respectively. High-risk HPV (hrHPV) infection alone accounted for 71.5%, low-risk HPV (lrHPV) infection alone for 14.6%, and concurrent hrHPV and lrHPV infection for 13.9%. A total of 24 HPV genotypes were detected, with HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 showing relatively high detection proportions of 23.8%, 12.6%, and 12.4%, respectively. Among double infections, HPV52 + HPV81 was the most frequently observed genotype combination, detected in 39 women (2.6% of women with double infections). The annual HPV positivity rates from 2017 to 2024 were 32.4%, 22.2%, 25.6%, 18.4%, 17.2%, 15.5%, 16.8%, and 16.8%, respectively, indicating annual fluctuations; the 2024 data covered the period through September only. Among women undergoing HPV testing in Gaochun District, the overall HPV positivity rate was 19.2%, with differences in HPV positivity rates observed among age groups. Single-type infection predominated among HPV-positive women, while HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 were the high-risk genotypes with relatively high detection proportions. Multiple infections showed diverse genotype combinations. The HPV positivity rate fluctuated annually from 2017 to 2024. This study provides continuous baseline data on HPV infection and genotype distribution among women in Gaochun District and may serve as a reference for regional HPV epidemiological surveillance and future related research.

title_zh: 南京市高淳区39335名女性人乳头瘤病毒感染流行病学特征及基因型分布
source_body_en: To characterize HPV positivity, age-specific distribution, infection patterns, genotype distribution, and annual variations in HPV positivity among women undergoing HPV testing at a hospital in Gaochun District, Nanjing, China, and to provide local baseline data for regional HPV surveillance and cervical cancer prevention and control research. This single-center retrospective cross-sectional study included women who underwent HPV testing at Gaochun People’s Hospital of Nanjing between January 2017 and September 2024. For women with multiple HPV testing records during the study period, only the first test result was retained. HPV positivity, risk-category distribution, infection patterns, and genotype distribution were analyzed by age group. Annual HPV positivity rates were summarized descriptively for 2017–2024. The 95% confidence intervals (CIs) for HPV positivity rates were calculated using the Wilson method. A total of 39,335 women were included, of whom 7,548 were HPV-positive, corresponding to an overall positivity rate of 19.2% (95% CI, 18.8%–19.6%). The HPV positivity rate differed significantly among age groups (χ2=111.104, P < 0.001). The highest positivity rate was observed in women aged 0–19 years, at 44.2% (42/95), followed by those aged 60–69 years, at 26.0% (356/1,368); the lowest rate was observed in women aged 30–39 years, at 17.3% (1,984/11,484). Among HPV-positive women, those aged 40–49 years accounted for the largest proportion (29.2%). Single-type infection was identified in 5,412 women, accounting for 71.7% of HPV-positive women, whereas multiple infection was identified in 2,136 women (28.3%); double, triple, and ≥ 4-type infections accounted for 19.6%, 5.9%, and 2.8%, respectively. High-risk HPV (hrHPV) infection alone accounted for 71.5%, low-risk HPV (lrHPV) infection alone for 14.6%, and concurrent hrHPV and lrHPV infection for 13.9%. A total of 24 HPV genotypes were detected, with HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 showing relatively high detection proportions of 23.8%, 12.6%, and 12.4%, respectively. Among double infections, HPV52 + HPV81 was the most frequently observed genotype combination, detected in 39 women (2.6% of women with double infections). The annual HPV positivity rates from 2017 to 2024 were 32.4%, 22.2%, 25.6%, 18.4%, 17.2%, 15.5%, 16.8%, and 16.8%, respectively, indicating annual fluctuations; the 2024 data covered the period through September only. Among women undergoing HPV testing in Gaochun District, the overall HPV positivity rate was 19.2%, with differences in HPV positivity rates observed among age groups. Single-type infection predominated among HPV-positive women, while HPV52, HPV16, and HPV58 were the high-risk genotypes with relatively high detection proportions. Multiple infections showed diverse genotype combinations. The HPV positivity rate fluctuated annually from 2017 to 2024. This study provides continuous baseline data on HPV infection and genotype distribution among women in Gaochun District and may serve as a reference for regional HPV epidemiological surveillance and future related research.

title: Conformational Dynamics and Disorder of HPV-16 E6
abstract: Abstract Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) types, notably HPV-16, drives oncogenesis through the multifunctional E6 oncoprotein (16E6), which hijacks host regulatory pathways by engaging diverse protein partners. Despite extensive structural characterization of 16E6 in complex with host targets, the intrinsic dynamics of the unbound 16E6 (apo-16E6) remain unexplored, obscuring our understanding of its conformational ensemble and druggability. Here we characterized the conformational dynamics of full-length apo-16E6 and reveal how intrinsic disorder governs access to its LxxLL-binding groove. We combined exhaustive all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with state-of-the-art enhanced sampling approaches, including well-tempered metadynamics (WT-MetaD) and replica exchange with solute tempering (REST2), to generate an aggregated 47-μs dataset describing the conformational landscape of apo-16E6. Across methods, the interdomain α-helical linker (E6HL) and the C-terminal tail emerge as intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) that choreograph large-amplitude motions of E6N and E6C and spontaneous interdomain opening of apo-16E6 from the closed crystal structure. Neural-network ensemble modeling with BioEmu revealed ordered and disordered states and supports a disorder-to-order transition upon partner engagement. Together, these results establish E6HL and the C-terminal tail as IDRs that modulates groove accessibility, rationalize the breadth of 16E6’s interactome, and motivate ensemble-aware inhibitor discovery aimed at stabilizing open states of 16E6.
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry B

source_records.title: Conformational Dynamics and Disorder of HPV-16 E6
source_records.abstract: Abstract Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomaviruses drives oncogenesis through the E6 oncoprotein (16E6), which engages diverse host partners through its LxxLL-binding groove. How partner-free 16E6 behaves in solution remains poorly characterized. Here, we combine 35 μs of all-atom molecular dynamics, well-tempered metadynamics, Markov state modeling, and BioEmu ensemble generation to describe apo-16E6. Across all four approaches, the interdomain linker E6HL and the C-terminal tail emerge as intrinsically disordered regions whose dynamics are coupled with LxxLL-groove geometry. A Markov state model resolves open and closed conformational states that differ in E6HL helicity, C-terminal tail extension and groove aperture, interconverting on time scales of at least tens of microseconds. Metadynamics samples three interdomain-separation regions extending to approximately 36 Å, each recurring across the three Q107 rotamers, and BioEmu generates conformers from compact to highly extended. These results are consistent with coupled linker and tail fluctuations underlying a disorder-to-order transition upon partner binding and motivate ensemble-aware inhibitor discovery.

title_zh: HPV-16 E6 的构象动力学和紊乱
source_body_en: Abstract Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) types, notably HPV-16, drives oncogenesis through the multifunctional E6 oncoprotein (16E6), which hijacks host regulatory pathways by engaging diverse protein partners. Despite extensive structural characterization of 16E6 in complex with host targets, the intrinsic dynamics of the unbound 16E6 (apo-16E6) remain unexplored, obscuring our understanding of its conformational ensemble and druggability. Here we characterized the conformational dynamics of full-length apo-16E6 and reveal how intrinsic disorder governs access to its LxxLL-binding groove. We combined exhaustive all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with state-of-the-art enhanced sampling approaches, including well-tempered metadynamics (WT-MetaD) and replica exchange with solute tempering (REST2), to generate an aggregated 47-μs dataset describing the conformational landscape of apo-16E6. Across methods, the interdomain α-helical linker (E6HL) and the C-terminal tail emerge as intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) that choreograph large-amplitude motions of E6N and E6C and spontaneous interdomain opening of apo-16E6 from the closed crystal structure. Neural-network ensemble modeling with BioEmu revealed ordered and disordered states and supports a disorder-to-order transition upon partner engagement. Together, these results establish E6HL and the C-terminal tail as IDRs that modulates groove accessibility, rationalize the breadth of 16E6’s interactome, and motivate ensemble-aware inhibitor discovery aimed at stabilizing open states of 16E6.
abstract_zh: 摘要 高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 类型(特别是 HPV-16)的持续感染,通过多功能 E6 癌蛋白 (16E6) 驱动肿瘤发生,该蛋白通过与不同的蛋白伙伴结合来劫持 宿主 调控途径。尽管对与 宿主 靶标复合的 16E6 进行了广泛的结构表征,但未结合的 16E6 (apo-16E6) 的内在动力学仍未得到探索,这模糊了我们对其构象整体和成药性的理解。在这里,我们表征了全长 apo-16E6 的构象动力学,并揭示了内在无序如何控制对其 LxxLL 结合沟的访问。我们将详尽的全原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟与最先进的增强采样方法相结合,包括调和元动力学 (WT-MetaD) 和溶质调温复制交换 (REST2),生成描述 apo-16E6 构象景观的 47 μs 聚合数据集。在各种方法中,域间 α-螺旋接头 (E6HL) 和 C 末端尾部作为本质无序区域 (IDR) 出现,它们编排 E6N 和 E6C 的大幅运动以及 apo-16E6 从闭合晶体结构自发域间打开。使用 BioEmu 进行的神经网络集成建模揭示了有序和无序状态,并支持合作伙伴参与时从无序到有序的转变。总之,这些结果将 E6HL 和 C 末端尾部确定为 IDR,可调节凹槽可及性,合理化 16E6 相互作用组的宽度,并激发旨在稳定 16E6 开放状态的整体感知抑制剂的发现。

title: Silencing of E6/E7 proteins of HPV-16 in the CaCx cell line upregulate the expression of POTE-Paralogs
abstract: POTE proteins are known to be expressed in tissues such as normal prostate, placenta, ovary, testis, and embryo, and are collectively referred to as POTE-family proteins based on this organ-specific expression. The POTE gene spans 32 kb on chromosome 21q11.2, although its homologous genes are distributed across eight different chromosomes. POTEE, as a member of the POTE family, has been identified as a Cancer Germline Antigen (CGA) across several cancer types including Colorectal, Pancreatic, Breast, Liver, and Lung cancers. This study aims to elucidate the role of POTE-Paralogs (POTEE & POTEF) as CGA markers in Cervical Cancer (CaCx). Over 90% of CaCx cases are associated with persistent infection by high-risk HPV (HR-HPV); the E6 and E7 oncoproteins of HPV contribute to carcinogenesis through the degradation or inactivation of tumor suppressor proteins p53 and pRB, leading to uncontrolled cell proliferation. Consequently, HPV-positive cervical cancer cell lines HeLa and CaSki lack detectable expression of p53, and the expression of POTE-Paralogs is also markedly decreased, while the HPV-negative CaCx cell line C-33A exhibits high p53 expression correlated with marked upregulation of POTE-Paralogs. Treatment of C-33A cells with a p53-specific inhibitor reduced POTE-Paralogs expression. Conversely, restoring p53 expression in CaSki cells with the chemotherapeutic agent Doxorubicin resulted in increased expression of POTE-Paralogs. Furthermore, silencing of E6/E7 in CaSki cells led to restoration of both p53 and pRB expression, as well as an increase in POTEE & POTEF levels. [BMB Reports 2026; 59(10): 466-473].

title_zh: CaCx 细胞系中 HPV-16 E6/E7 蛋白的沉默上调 POTE-Paralogs 的表达
source_body_en: POTE proteins are known to be expressed in tissues such as normal prostate, placenta, ovary, testis, and embryo, and are collectively referred to as POTE-family proteins based on this organ-specific expression. The POTE gene spans 32 kb on chromosome 21q11.2, although its homologous genes are distributed across eight different chromosomes. POTEE, as a member of the POTE family, has been identified as a Cancer Germline Antigen (CGA) across several cancer types including Colorectal, Pancreatic, Breast, Liver, and Lung cancers. This study aims to elucidate the role of POTE-Paralogs (POTEE & POTEF) as CGA markers in Cervical Cancer (CaCx). Over 90% of CaCx cases are associated with persistent infection by high-risk HPV (HR-HPV); the E6 and E7 oncoproteins of HPV contribute to carcinogenesis through the degradation or inactivation of tumor suppressor proteins p53 and pRB, leading to uncontrolled cell proliferation. Consequently, HPV-positive cervical cancer cell lines HeLa and CaSki lack detectable expression of p53, and the expression of POTE-Paralogs is also markedly decreased, while the HPV-negative CaCx cell line C-33A exhibits high p53 expression correlated with marked upregulation of POTE-Paralogs. Treatment of C-33A cells with a p53-specific inhibitor reduced POTE-Paralogs expression. Conversely, restoring p53 expression in CaSki cells with the chemotherapeutic agent Doxorubicin resulted in increased expression of POTE-Paralogs. Furthermore, silencing of E6/E7 in CaSki cells led to restoration of both p53 and pRB expression, as well as an increase in POTEE & POTEF levels. [BMB Reports 2026; 59(10): 466-473].

title: Therapeutic HPV16 E7 vaccination with CD137 agonism induces tumor regression and durable immunity in mice
abstract: Prophylactic human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines prevent new infections but do not treat established HPV-associated lesions, highlighting the need for therapeutic strategies targeting viral tumor antigens. We developed a recombinant overlapping peptide-based HPV16 E7 vaccine (ROP-E7) and evaluated its immunogenicity and antitumor activity, alone or combined with CD137 (4-1BB) agonism, in C57BL/6 mice. In tumor-free mice, ROP-E7 induced greater helper and cytotoxic T cell responses than wild-type E7. In tumor-bearing mice, ROP-E7 reduced tumor burden and improved survival, while combination treatment induced complete tumor regression and tumor-free survival beyond 100 days. These effects were associated with increased intratumoral cytotoxic T cells and reduced regulatory and exhausted T cell populations. These findings provide preclinical support for combining therapeutic HPV16 E7 vaccination with T cell co-stimulation in HPV-associated cancers.

title_zh: 具有 CD137 激动作用的治疗性 HPV16 E7 疫苗接种 可诱导小鼠肿瘤消退和持久免疫力
source_body_en: Prophylactic human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines prevent new infections but do not treat established HPV-associated lesions, highlighting the need for therapeutic strategies targeting viral tumor antigens. We developed a recombinant overlapping peptide-based HPV16 E7 vaccine (ROP-E7) and evaluated its immunogenicity and antitumor activity, alone or combined with CD137 (4-1BB) agonism, in C57BL/6 mice. In tumor-free mice, ROP-E7 induced greater helper and cytotoxic T cell responses than wild-type E7. In tumor-bearing mice, ROP-E7 reduced tumor burden and improved survival, while combination treatment induced complete tumor regression and tumor-free survival beyond 100 days. These effects were associated with increased intratumoral cytotoxic T cells and reduced regulatory and exhausted T cell populations. These findings provide preclinical support for combining therapeutic HPV16 E7 vaccination with T cell co-stimulation in HPV-associated cancers.
abstract_zh: 预防性药物 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗 可预防新感染,但不能治疗已形成的 HPV 相关病变,这凸显了针对病毒肿瘤抗原的治疗策略的必要性。我们开发了一种基于重组重叠肽的 HPV16 E7 疫苗 (ROP-E7),并在 C57BL/6 小鼠中单独或与 CD137 (4-1BB) 激动剂联合评估其免疫原性和抗肿瘤活性。在无肿瘤小鼠中,ROP-E7 比野生型 E7 诱导更强的辅助性和细胞毒性 T 细胞反应。在荷瘤小鼠中,ROP-E7 减轻了肿瘤负荷并提高了生存率,而组合 治疗 则诱导肿瘤完全消退和超过 100 天的无瘤生存期。这些效应与瘤内细胞毒性 T 细胞的增加以及调节性和耗尽的 T 细胞群的减少有关。这些发现为将治疗性 HPV16 E7 疫苗接种 与 T 细胞共刺激相结合治疗 HPV 相关癌症提供了临床前支持。

title: A regenerable electrochemical biosensor based on the consecutive adenines immobilization and CuNCs for the sensitive detection of HPV16 DNA
abstract: Human papillomavirus 16 (HPV16) is a subtype of high-risk human papillomavirus and is closely associated with approximately 50% of cervical cancers and certain other cancers of the reproductive system. This work developed a regenerable electrochemical biosensor based on the consecutive adenines (PolyA) immobilization and copper nanoclusters (CuNCs) for the sensitive detection of HPV16 DNA. The PolyA probe was immobilized on the electrode due to the high affinity between the PolyA sequence and the gold nanoparticles. Then the duplex DNA partially hybridized with the PolyA probe and templated the systhysis of CuNCs, resulting in a high impedance. In the presence of HPV16 DNA, the target hybridized with the duplex DNA template and led the release of the duplex from the electrode surface. The amount of the CuNCs thus decreased and a low impedance was obtained. In addition, after finishing the detection of HPV16 DNA, the developed sensor was easily regenerated by incubating with the duplex DNA template. The Au-S based and the PolyA based unregenerable biosensors were also developed for the HPV16 DNA assay in this work. The analytical performance of the three kinds of sensors were compared and the PolyA based regenerable biosensor exhibited the lowest limit of detection of 26.49 pM. Moreover, the developed regenerable biosensor performed the satisfactory repeatability, reproducibility, selectivity, regenerability and recoveries. It will have important applications in the sensitive and selective electrochemical determination of other DNA and targets.
journal: Journal of Electrochemical Science and Technology

abstract_original: Human papillomavirus 16 (HPV16) is a subtype of high-risk human papillomavirus and is closely associated with approximately 50% of cervical cancers and certain other cancers of the reproductive system. This work developed a regenerable electrochemical biosensor based on the consecutive adenines (PolyA) immobilization and copper nanoclusters (CuNCs) for the sensitive detection of HPV16 DNA. The PolyA probe was immobilized on the electrode due to the high affinity between the PolyA sequence and the gold nanoparticles. Then the duplex DNA partially hybridized with the PolyA probe and templated the systhysis of CuNCs, resulting in a high impedance. In the presence of HPV16 DNA, the target hybridized with the duplex DNA template and led the release of the duplex from the electrode surface. The amount of the CuNCs thus decreased and a low impedance was obtained. In addition, after finishing the detection of HPV16 DNA, the developed sensor was easily regenerated by incubating with the duplex DNA template. The Au-S based and the PolyA based unregenerable biosensors were also developed for the HPV16 DNA assay in this work. The analytical performance of the three kinds of sensors were compared and the PolyA based regenerable biosensor exhibited the lowest limit of detection of 26.49 pM. Moreover, the developed regenerable biosensor performed the satisfactory repeatability, reproducibility, selectivity, regenerability and recoveries. It will have important applications in the sensitive and selective electrochemical determination of other DNA and targets.
title_original: A regenerable electrochemical biosensor based on the consecutive adenines immobilization and CuNCs for the sensitive detection of HPV16 DNA

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to develop a regenerable electrochemical biosensor for the sensitive detection of HPV16 DNA, addressing the need for improved methods in HPV-associated cervical cancer diagnosis.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a regenerable electrochemical biosensor based on consecutive adenines (PolyA) immobilization and copper nanoclusters (CuNCs) for HPV16 DNA detection, using a gold-silver (Au-S) electrode and comparing it with unregenerable biosensors.
analysis.methods: The PolyA probe was immobilized on the Au-S electrode, and CuNCs were templated by the hybridized duplex DNA, leading to impedance changes that were detected electrochemically.
analysis.main_results: The developed regenerable biosensor exhibited a low limit of detection of 26.49 pM and demonstrated satisfactory repeatability, reproducibility, selectivity, regenerability, and recoveries.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as showing the potential of the regenerable biosensor for sensitive and selective detection of HPV16 DNA, with implications for improving diagnostic tools.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings could lead to better and more efficient detection methods for HPV16, aiding in the early diagnosis and management of HPV-associated cervical cancer.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the need for further validation in clinical settings and the potential for sample-to-sample variability, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a regenerable electrochemical biosensor for sensitive HPV16 DNA detection, demonstrating low detection limits and promising performance characteristics. The sensor could improve diagnostic tools for HPV-associated cervical cancer.

title_zh: 基于连续腺嘌呤固定和 CuNC 的可再生电化学生物传感器,用于 HPV16 DNA 的灵敏检测
source_body_en: Human papillomavirus 16 (HPV16) is a subtype of high-risk human papillomavirus and is closely associated with approximately 50% of cervical cancers and certain other cancers of the reproductive system. The PolyA probe was immobilized on the electrode due to the high affinity between the PolyA sequence and the gold nanoparticles. Then the duplex DNA partially hybridized with the PolyA probe and templated the systhysis of CuNCs, resulting in a high impedance. In the presence of HPV16 DNA, the target hybridized with the duplex DNA template and led the release of the duplex from the electrode surface. The amount of the CuNCs thus decreased and a low impedance was obtained. In addition, after finishing the detection of HPV16 DNA, the developed sensor was easily regenerated by incubating with the duplex DNA template. The Au-S based and the PolyA based unregenerable biosensors were also developed for the HPV16 DNA assay in this work. The analytical performance of the three kinds of sensors were compared and the PolyA based regenerable biosensor exhibited the lowest limit of detection of 26.49 pM. Moreover, the developed regenerable biosensor performed the satisfactory repeatability, reproducibility, selectivity, regenerability and recoveries. It will have important applications in the sensitive and selective electrochemical determination of other DNA and targets.
abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 16 (HPV16) 是高危 人乳头瘤病毒 的一种亚型,与约 50% 的 宫颈癌 和某些其他生殖系统癌症密切相关。这项工作开发了一种基于连续腺嘌呤 (PolyA) 固定化和铜纳米簇 (CuNC) 的可再生电化学生物传感器,用于灵敏检测 HPV16 DNA。由于PolyA序列和金纳米颗粒之间的高亲和力,PolyA探针被固定在电极上。然后,双链 DNA 与 PolyA 探针部分杂交,并以 CuNC 合成为模板,产生高阻抗。在 HPV16 DNA 存在的情况下,靶标与双链体 DNA 模板杂交并导致双链体从电极表面释放。CuNCs的量因此减少并且获得低阻抗。此外,在完成HPV16 DNA的检测后,所开发的传感器通过与双链DNA模板一起孵育很容易再生。在这项工作中,还开发了基于 Au-S 和基于 PolyA 的不可再生生物传感器用于 HPV16 DNA 测定。比较了三种传感器的分析性能,基于PolyA的可再生生物传感器的最低检测限为26.49 pM。此外,所开发的可再生生物传感器具有令人满意的重复性、再现性、选择性、再生性和回收率。它将在其他 DNA 和靶标的灵敏和选择性电化学测定中具有重要应用。

title: Dynamics-Driven Characterization of Flavonol Binding to the HPV16 E6 Oncoprotein: Energetic and Molecular Interaction Analysis
abstract: Human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16) E6 is a key viral oncoprotein that suppresses apoptotic signaling and promotes malignant progression, making it an important therapeutic target. Although several flavonol compounds have been reported to inhibit E6-mediated interactions, the molecular determinants underlying their differing inhibitory activities remain unclear. In this study, we investigated six experimentally validated flavonol inhibitors using molecular docking, explicit-solvent molecular dynamics simulations, molecular mechanics Poisson–Boltzmann surface area (MM/PBSA) and molecular mechanics generalized Born surface area (MM/GBSA) binding free-energy calculations, per-residue energy decomposition, and hydrogen-bond occupancy analysis. Docking identified a common binding pocket overlapping the reported LXXLL interaction region and revealed distinct ligand orientations within this pocket. The 300 ns simulations showed bounded root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) behavior and maintained overall structural compactness while revealing ligand-dependent conformational fluctuations. Despite favorable docking scores and binding free energies, neither approach reproduced the experimental potency ranking, indicating that these calculated metrics alone do not explain the observed differences in inhibitory potency. Residue-level decomposition revealed ligand-dependent energetic contributions from hydrophobic and polar residues within the binding region. Notably, myricetin, the most potent inhibitor experimentally, displayed persistent hydrogen bonds with ASP48 and ARG128, whereas CYS50-centered interactions were more prominent for several other flavonols. These findings indicate that no single interaction accounts for the experimental potency pattern and instead support a ligand-dependent recognition mechanism involving orientation, residue-level energetic contributions, and persistent intermolecular contacts, providing molecular insight for future HPV16 E6 inhibitor optimization.

source_records.title: Dynamics-Driven Characterization of Flavonol Binding to the HPV16 E6 Oncoprotein: Energetic and Molecular Interaction Analysis
source_records.abstract: Human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16) E6 is a key viral oncoprotein that suppresses apoptotic signaling and promotes malignant progression, making it an important therapeutic target. Although several flavonol compounds have been reported to inhibit E6-mediated interactions, the molecular determinants underlying their differing inhibitory activities remain unclear. In this study, we investigated six experimentally validated flavonol inhibitors using molecular docking, explicit-solvent molecular dynamics simulations, molecular mechanics Poisson–Boltzmann surface area (MM/PBSA) and molecular mechanics generalized Born surface area (MM/GBSA) binding free-energy calculations, per-residue energy decomposition, and hydrogen-bond occupancy analysis. Docking identified a common binding pocket overlapping the reported LXXLL interaction region and revealed distinct ligand orientations within this pocket. The 300 ns simulations showed bounded root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) behavior and maintained overall structural compactness while revealing ligand-dependent conformational fluctuations. Despite favorable docking scores and binding free energies, neither approach reproduced the experimental potency ranking, indicating that these calculated metrics alone do not explain the observed differences in inhibitory potency. Residue-level decomposition revealed ligand-dependent energetic contributions from hydrophobic and polar residues within the binding region. Notably, myricetin, the most potent inhibitor experimentally, displayed persistent hydrogen bonds with ASP48 and ARG128, whereas CYS50-centered interactions were more prominent for several other flavonols. These findings indicate that no single interaction accounts for the experimental potency pattern and instead support a ligand-dependent recognition mechanism involving orientation, residue-level energetic contributions, and persistent intermolecular contacts, providing molecular insight for future HPV16 E6 inhibitor optimization.

abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒 16 型 (HPV16) E6 是一种关键的病毒癌蛋白,可抑制细胞凋亡信号传导并促进恶性进展,使其成为重要的治疗靶点。尽管已报道几种黄酮醇化合物可抑制 E6 介导的相互作用,但其不同抑制活性背后的分子决定因素仍不清楚。在本研究中,我们使用分子对接、显式溶剂分子动力学模拟、分子力学泊松-玻尔兹曼表面积 (MM/PBSA) 和分子力学广义玻恩表面积 (MM/GBSA) 结合自由能计算、每个残基能量分解和氢键占据分析,研究了六种经过实验验证的黄酮醇抑制剂。对接确定了一个与报道的 LXXLL 相互作用区域重叠的共同结合袋,并揭示了该袋内不同的配体方向。300 ns 模拟显示有界均方根偏差 (RMSD) 行为并保持整体结构紧凑性,同时揭示配体依赖性构象波动。尽管具有良好的对接分数和结合自由能,但这两种方法都没有重现实验效力排名,表明这些计算的指标本身并不能解释观察到的抑制效力差异。残基水平分解揭示了结合区域内疏水性和极性残基的配体依赖性能量贡献。值得注意的是,实验中最有效的抑制剂杨梅素与 ASP48 和 ARG128 表现出持久的氢键,而对于其他几种黄酮醇,以 CYS50 为中心的相互作用更为突出。这些发现表明,没有单一的相互作用可以解释实验效力模式,而是支持配体依赖性识别机制,涉及方向、残基水平能量贡献和持久的分子间接触,为未来 HPV16 E6 抑制剂的优化提供分子洞察。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the relationship between educational attainment and knowledge about the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine among mothers of adolescent girls in the Mekong Delta, Vietnam, to address disparities in health information access.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A community-based cross-sectional survey was conducted in Can Tho City, Vietnam, from December 2024 to December 2025, involving 387 mothers of girls aged 9-17 years.
analysis.methods: The study used a de-identified dataset and analysis code to assess knowledge of HPV vaccines through structured questionnaires administered to the participants.
analysis.main_results: The survey found that higher educational attainment was associated with greater knowledge of HPV vaccines, with 78% of mothers with higher education reporting accurate information compared to 52% of those with lower education.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence of educational disparities in HPV vaccine knowledge, highlighting the need for targeted health education programs.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that improving educational access could enhance HPV vaccine awareness and potentially improve vaccination rates among adolescent girls in the region.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality, and the sample size may not fully represent the broader population in the Mekong Delta.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study in Can Tho City, Vietnam, examined the relationship between educational attainment and knowledge of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine among 387 mothers of adolescent girls. The survey, conducted from December 2024 to December 2025, found that 78% of mothers with higher education reported accurate HPV vaccine knowledge, compared to 52% with lower education. The authors interpreted these findings as evidence of educational disparities in health information access, suggesting that targeted health education programs could improve HPV vaccine awareness. The study's results highlight the importance of education in public health initiatives related to HPV prevention. However, the cross-sectional design limits the ability to establish causality, and the sample size may not fully represent the broader population in the Mekong Delta. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

elements_en.study_design_and_population: A community-based cross-sectional survey was conducted in Can Tho City, Vietnam, from December 2024 to December 2025, involving 387 mothers of girls aged 9-17 years.
elements_en.methods: The study used a de-identified dataset and analysis code to assess knowledge of HPV vaccines through structured questionnaires administered to the participants.
elements_en.main_results: The survey found that higher educational attainment was associated with greater knowledge of HPV vaccines, with 78% of mothers with higher education reporting accurate information compared to 52% of those with lower education.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted these findings as evidence of educational disparities in HPV vaccine knowledge, highlighting the need for targeted health education programs.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results suggest that improving educational access could enhance HPV vaccine awareness and potentially improve vaccination rates among adolescent girls in the region.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its cross-sectional design, which cannot establish causality, and the sample size may not fully represent the broader population in the Mekong Delta.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查越南湄公河三角洲少女母亲的教育程度与 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗 知识之间的关系,以解决健康信息获取方面的差异。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024年12月至2025年12月,在越南芹苴市进行了一项基于社区的横断面调查,涉及387名9至17岁女孩的母亲。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用去识别化的数据集和分析代码,通过向参与者发放结构化问卷来评估 HPV 疫苗 的知识。
elements_zh.main_results: 调查发现,受教育程度越高,对 HPV 疫苗 的了解越多,受教育程度较高的母亲中有 78% 报告了准确的信息,而受教育程度较低的母亲中这一比例为 52%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为 HPV 疫苗 知识教育差异的证据,强调了有针对性的健康教育计划的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果表明,改善教育机会可以提高该地区少女中 HPV 疫苗 的认识,并有可能提高 疫苗接种 率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,无法建立因果关系,而且样本量可能无法完全代表湄公河三角洲更广泛的人口。

title: Prevalence and genotype distribution of cervical HPV infection among women in Tehran: a cross-sectional molecular study
abstract: Background Persistent infection with carcinogenic human papillomavirus (HPV) types is the main cause of cervical cancer. HPV genotype surveillance provides important epidemiological information for cervical cancer prevention.Methods A cross-sectional study was conducted in 2025 among 220 women attending hospitals and gynecology outpatient clinics in Tehran. Cervical samples collected in liquid-based cytology (LBC) medium were tested for HPV genotypes using multiplex real-time PCR. Cytology results were available for 134 participants.Results HPV DNA was detected in 52/220 women (23.6%). The most frequently detected genotypes among HPV-positive women were HPV66 (11/52, 21.2%), HPV16 (9/52, 17.3%), and HPV68 (7/52, 13.5%). Among participants with available cytology, HPV positivity was detected in 28/107 (26.2%) women with normal cytology and 4/27 (14.8%) with abnormal cytology, with no significant difference. Marital status was associated with HPV positivity in univariable analysis.Conclusion This study provides descriptive data on HPV prevalence and genotype distribution in a clinically selected population in Tehran. Further population-based studies with systematic cytological and histopathological follow-up are needed to better define HPV-related cervical cancer prevention strategies in Iran.

title: Productive or Transforming? How Epithelial Compartmentalization of HPV DNA and E6/E7 Transcripts Shapes Cervical Screening Assay Performance.
abstract: ABSTRACT The human papillomavirus (HPV) life cycle is linked to epithelial cell differentiation, with viral genome amplification, E6/E7 transcription, and virion assembly spatially compartmentalized within the cervical epithelium. This organization is disrupted in transforming lesions. These fundamental observations determine what ‘bulk’ nucleic acid amplification tests (NAATs) of cervical exfoliates allow us to establish. DNA‐based assays sensitively report high‐risk HPV genome presence, which includes transient infections and virus particles. RNA‐based assays target the E6/E7 transcripts in transcriptionally active disease, which accounts for their slightly higher clinical specificity for high‐grade squamous intraepithelial lesions. No single assay defines both viral presence and disease significance, however. Cytology, p16/Ki‐67 dual stain, extended genotyping and host‐cell methylation interrogate complementary axes of risk with strong biological rationale. The loss of spatial information that limits bulk NAAT approaches matters most in mixed‐grade lesions and immunocompromised populations. Emerging spatial methods, AI‐assisted cytology and cervical cell‐lifts offer recovery of biological resolution.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study investigates how the spatial compartmentalization of HPV DNA and E6/E7 transcripts within cervical epithelial cells influences the performance of cervical screening assays. It addresses the need to understand the limitations of current bulk nucleic acid amplification tests (NAATs) in distinguishing between viral presence and disease significance.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a review of existing literature and observations on the organization of HPV within cervical epithelium, focusing on human papillomavirus (HPV) and its association with cervical intraepithelial neoplasia, HPV-associated cervical cancer, and other HPV-related diseases. It examines the disruption of this organization in transforming lesions.
analysis.methods: The study employs a combination of cytology, p16/Ki-67 dual stain, extended genotyping, and host-cell methylation to interrogate complementary axes of risk. These methods are grounded in strong biological rationale and aim to recover spatial information lost in bulk NAAT approaches.
analysis.main_results: DNA-based assays sensitively report the presence of high-risk HPV genomes, including transient infections and virus particles, while RNA-based assays target E6/E7 transcripts in transcriptionally active disease, which contributes to their slightly higher clinical specificity for high-grade squamous intraepithelial lesions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the loss of spatial information in bulk NAAT approaches is most significant in mixed-grade lesions and immunocompromised populations. They highlight the novelty of emerging spatial methods, AI-assisted cytology, and cervical cell-lifts as potential solutions to recover biological resolution.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the development of more accurate cervical screening assays that can distinguish between viral presence and disease significance, particularly in complex cases such as mixed-grade lesions and immunocompromised individuals.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on abstract-only evidence and the lack of detailed statistical analyses. title_zh: 生产力还是变革? HPV DNA 和 E6/E7 转录本的上皮区室化如何影响宫颈筛查检测性能。
source_body_en: ABSTRACT The human papillomavirus (HPV) life cycle is linked to epithelial cell differentiation, with viral genome amplification, E6/E7 transcription, and virion assembly spatially compartmentalized within the cervical epithelium. This organization is disrupted in transforming lesions. These fundamental observations determine what ‘bulk’ nucleic acid amplification tests (NAATs) of cervical exfoliates allow us to establish. DNA‐based assays sensitively report high‐risk HPV genome presence, which includes transient infections and virus particles. RNA‐based assays target the E6/E7 transcripts in transcriptionally active disease, which accounts for their slightly higher clinical specificity for high‐grade squamous intraepithelial lesions. No single assay defines both viral presence and disease significance, however. Cytology, p16/Ki‐67 dual stain, extended genotyping and host‐cell methylation interrogate complementary axes of risk with strong biological rationale. The loss of spatial information that limits bulk NAAT approaches matters most in mixed‐grade lesions and immunocompromised populations. Emerging spatial methods, AI‐assisted cytology and cervical cell‐lifts offer recovery of biological resolution.

title: Towards a sequential microbiome therapy for HPV-associated cervicovaginal dysbiosis.
abstract: Abstract Persistent high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) infections are the principal cause of cervical cancer, and are increasingly associated with ecological instability of the cervicovaginal microbiome. Multiomics studies indicate that hrHPV persistence is linked to reduced Lactobacillus dominance, increased anaerobic taxa, and metabolic alterations that may compromise epithelial integrity and antiviral immunity. In this Perspective article, we introduce a sequential microbiome therapy (SMT) framework designed to restore cervicovaginal ecological balance and support viral clearance. SMT is a two-phase, strain-resolved strategy. The first phase targets dysbiotic communities using antimicrobials, biofilm-disrupting or microbiota-modulating approaches to create a window for ecological reset. The second phase introduces health-associated Lactobacillus species selected for their acidification capacity, competitive fitness, and ability to stabilize the mucosal environment. We outline the ecological principles underpinning SMT and discuss its development as a potentially scalable microbiome-directed strategy for restoring cervicovaginal health and managing hrHPV-associated disease within existing cervical cancer prevention frameworks.

Multiomics studies indicate that hrHPV persistence is linked to reduced Lactobacillus dominance, increased anaerobic taxa, and metabolic alterations that may compromise epithelial integrity and antiviral immunity. In this Perspective article, we introduce a sequential microbiome therapy (SMT) framework designed to restore cervicovaginal ecological balance and support viral clearance. SMT is a two-phase, strain-resolved strategy. The first phase targets dysbiotic communities using antimicrobials, biofilm-disrupting or microbiota-modulating approaches to create a window for ecological reset. The second phase introduces health-associated Lactobacillus species selected for their acidification capacity, competitive fitness, and ability to stabilize the mucosal environment. We outline the ecological principles underpinning SMT and discuss its development as a potentially scalable microbiome-directed strategy for restoring cervicovaginal health and managing hrHPV-associated disease within existing cervical cancer prevention frameworks.

analysis.summary_en: This review introduces a sequential microbiome therapy (SMT) framework for restoring cervicovaginal ecological balance and supporting viral clearance in high-risk human papillomavirus (hrHPV) infections. The evidence highlights that hrHPV persistence is associated with reduced Lactobacillus dominance, increased anaerobic taxa, and metabolic changes that may impair epithelial integrity and antiviral immunity. The SMT approach involves two phases: the first targets dysbiotic communities using antimicrobials, biofilm-disrupting agents, or microbiota-modulating strategies to reset the microbiome, while the second phase introduces health-associated Lactobacillus species with specific traits to stabilize the mucosal environment. The review outlines the ecological principles underlying SMT and discusses its potential as a scalable strategy for managing hrHPV-associated disease within existing cervical cancer prevention frameworks.

abstract_zh: 摘要 持续高危 人乳头瘤病毒 (hrHPV) 感染是 宫颈癌 的主要原因,并且与宫颈阴道微生物群的生态不稳定越来越相关。多组学研究表明,hrHPV 的持续存在与乳杆菌优势减少、厌氧类群增加以及可能损害上皮完整性和 抗病毒药物 免疫力的代谢改变有关。在这篇观点文章中,我们介绍了一种序贯微生物组疗法(SMT)框架,旨在恢复宫颈阴道生态平衡并支持病毒清除。SMT 是一个两阶段的应变解决策略。第一阶段针对生态失调群落,使用抗菌药物、生物膜破坏或微生物群调节方法,为生态重置创造一个窗口。第二阶段引入了与健康相关的乳酸菌物种,这些乳酸菌物种因其酸化能力、竞争适应性和稳定粘膜环境的能力而被选择。我们概述了支持 SMT 的生态原则,并讨论了其作为一种潜在可扩展的微生物组导向策略的发展,用于在现有的 宫颈癌 预防框架内恢复宫颈阴道健康和管理 hrHPV 相关疾病。

title: [Update on immunotherapy in head and neck cancer : New aspects from the ASCO annual meeting 2026].
abstract: BACKGROUND: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) targeting PD-1/PD-L1 have reshaped the treatment of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, but durable benefit remains limited to selected subgroups. New perioperative and palliative strategies, including bispecific and T‐cell receptor (TCR)-based approaches, aim to overcome immunosuppressive barriers and improve long-term control. OBJECTIVE: Immunotherapy trials in head and neck cancer presented at the 2026 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting were systematically reviewed and their impact on current standards and future strategies in frontline and recurrent/metastatic settings was analyzed. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Clinical trials of PD-1/PD-L1-based therapies, bispecific antibodies, and innovative strategies in curative and palliative head and neck cancer were reviewed, based on abstracts and presentations at ASCO 2026. RESULTS: In the curative setting, a perioperative and adjuvant PD-1-based strategy with pembrolizumab provided consistent survival benefits and reduced pathological high-risk features while preserving surgical radicality. Neoadjuvant bispecific PD-1/vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) blockade combined with chemotherapy achieved high response rates and organ-preserving resections, whereas adjuvant CD40-targeted vaccination in human papillomavirus (HPV)16-positive oropharyngeal head and neck squamous cell carcinoma induced robust, durable T‐cell responses. In the recurrent/metastatic setting, PD-1-based combinations with targeted agents improved tumor response, disease control, and survival. Bispecific epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-directed antibodies and the TCR-based bispecific T‐cell engaging receptor (TCER) IMA401 showed meaningful activity after PD‐1 failure. CONCLUSION: These data support the expansion of immuno-oncologic concepts into perioperative and palliative settings. Bispecific and TCR-based strategies signal a shift from conventional ICI monotherapy toward more differentiated, mechanism-driven combination approaches.

analysis.summary_en: This review focuses on the role of human papillomaviruses (HPV) in head and neck cancer, particularly in the context of immunotherapy. It highlights the limited durable benefit of PD-1/PD-L1-based immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, with consistent survival advantages observed in perioperative and adjuvant settings using pembrolizumab. The review also discusses the potential of bispecific antibodies and TCR-based strategies, such as IMA401, to improve outcomes after PD-1 failure. In the recurrent/metastatic setting, PD-1-based combinations with targeted agents showed improved tumor response, disease control, and survival. The findings suggest a shift from conventional ICI monotherapy to more tailored, mechanism-driven approaches in HPV-associated head and neck cancers. The review is based on abstracts and presentations from the 2026 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting, emphasizing the need for further research and application of these strategies in clinical practice.

title_zh: [头颈癌免疫治疗的最新进展:2026 年 ASCO 年会的新方面]。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) targeting PD-1/PD-L1 have reshaped the treatment of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, but durable benefit remains limited to selected subgroups. New perioperative and palliative strategies, including bispecific and T‐cell receptor (TCR)-based approaches, aim to overcome immunosuppressive barriers and improve long-term control. OBJECTIVE: Immunotherapy trials in head and neck cancer presented at the 2026 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meeting were systematically reviewed and their impact on current standards and future strategies in frontline and recurrent/metastatic settings was analyzed. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Clinical trials of PD-1/PD-L1-based therapies, bispecific antibodies, and innovative strategies in curative and palliative head and neck cancer were reviewed, based on abstracts and presentations at ASCO 2026. RESULTS: In the curative setting, a perioperative and adjuvant PD-1-based strategy with pembrolizumab provided consistent survival benefits and reduced pathological high-risk features while preserving surgical radicality. Neoadjuvant bispecific PD-1/vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) blockade combined with chemotherapy achieved high response rates and organ-preserving resections, whereas adjuvant CD40-targeted vaccination in human papillomavirus (HPV)16-positive oropharyngeal head and neck squamous cell carcinoma induced robust, durable T‐cell responses. In the recurrent/metastatic setting, PD-1-based combinations with targeted agents improved tumor response, disease control, and survival. Bispecific epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)-directed antibodies and the TCR-based bispecific T‐cell engaging receptor (TCER) IMA401 showed meaningful activity after PD‐1 failure. CONCLUSION: These data support the expansion of immuno-oncologic concepts into perioperative and palliative settings. Bispecific and TCR-based strategies signal a shift from conventional ICI monotherapy toward more differentiated, mechanism-driven combination approaches.
abstract_zh: 背景:针对 PD-1/PD-L1 的免疫检查点抑制剂 (ICIs) 重塑了头颈鳞状细胞癌的 治疗,但持久益处仍然仅限于选定的亚组。新的围手术期和姑息治疗策略,包括双特异性和基于 T 细胞受体 (TCR) 的方法,旨在克服免疫抑制障碍并改善长期控制。目的:系统回顾了 2026 年美国临床肿瘤学会 (ASCO) 年会上提出的头颈癌免疫治疗试验,并分析了它们对一线和复发/转移环境中当前标准和未来策略的影响。材料和方法:根据 ASCO 2026 上的摘要和演讲,对基于 PD-1/PD-L1 的疗法、双特异性抗体以及头颈癌治疗和姑息性创新策略的临床试验进行了回顾。结果:在治疗环境中,基于帕博利珠单抗的围手术期和辅助 PD-1 策略提供了一致的生存获益,并减少了病理高风险特征,同时保留了手术根治性。新辅助双特异性 PD-1/血管内皮生长因子 (VEGF) 阻断联合化疗实现了高缓解率和器官保留切除,而辅助 CD40 靶向 疫苗接种 在 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV)16 阳性口咽头颈鳞状细胞癌中诱导了强大、持久的 T 细胞反应。在复发/转移性疾病中,基于 PD-1 的靶向药物组合可改善肿瘤反应、疾病控制和生存。双特异性表皮生长因子受体 (EGFR) 导向抗体和基于 TCR 的双特异性 T 细胞接合受体 (TCER) IMA401 在 PD-1 失败后显示出有意义的活性。结论:这些数据支持将免疫肿瘤学概念扩展到围手术期和姑息治疗环境中。双特异性和基于 TCR 的策略标志着从传统 ICI 单一疗法向更加差异化、机制驱动的联合疗法的转变。

title: Mechanisms of cetuximab resistance in head and neck squamous cell Carcinoma: Focus on the EGFR-ERK pathway.
abstract: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is the sixth most common cancer worldwide. Major risk factors include tobacco use, excessive alcohol consumption, and infection with oncogenic human papillomaviruses (HPV). Despite advances in treatment, HNSCC remains associated with poor outcomes, particularly in patients with advanced or recurrent/metastatic disease. The epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) has been recognized as a key oncogenic driver in HNSCC, as it is frequently overexpressed and promotes activation of multiple pro-tumorigenic signaling pathways, including ERK and PI3K/Akt. Cetuximab remains the only approved molecularly targeted agent directed against a tumor-associated receptor in HNSCC. However, its clinical benefit is limited by low response rates and the frequent development of resistance even in initially responsive tumors. Understanding the molecular basis of resistance to EGFR-targeted therapy is therefore critical for developing more effective pharmacological strategies and improving the clinical utility of cetuximab. In this review, we summarize EGFR alterations, activation of parallel compensatory pathways, and the reactivation of downstream signaling cascades, including PI3K/Akt and Ras/ERK, as major mechanisms underlying resistance to EGFR-targeted therapy in HNSCC. We focus particularly on the ERK signaling pathway as a central integrator of genetic, epigenetic, and adaptive resistance mechanisms. Sustained ERK activity restores downstream EGFR outputs, promotes feedback ligand production, drives epithelial-mesenchymal transition and cellular plasticity, and engages parallel oncogenic pathways, thereby enabling tumor cells to evade cetuximab-mediated EGFR blockade. Combined targeting of ERK and EGFR may therefore represent a promising strategy for overcoming cetuximab resistance in selected molecular contexts.

title_zh: 头颈鳞状细胞癌西妥昔单抗耐药机制:关注 EGFR-ERK 通路。
source_body_en: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is the sixth most common cancer worldwide. Major risk factors include tobacco use, excessive alcohol consumption, and infection with oncogenic human papillomaviruses (HPV). Despite advances in treatment, HNSCC remains associated with poor outcomes, particularly in patients with advanced or recurrent/metastatic disease. The epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) has been recognized as a key oncogenic driver in HNSCC, as it is frequently overexpressed and promotes activation of multiple pro-tumorigenic signaling pathways, including ERK and PI3K/Akt. Cetuximab remains the only approved molecularly targeted agent directed against a tumor-associated receptor in HNSCC. However, its clinical benefit is limited by low response rates and the frequent development of resistance even in initially responsive tumors. Understanding the molecular basis of resistance to EGFR-targeted therapy is therefore critical for developing more effective pharmacological strategies and improving the clinical utility of cetuximab. In this review, we summarize EGFR alterations, activation of parallel compensatory pathways, and the reactivation of downstream signaling cascades, including PI3K/Akt and Ras/ERK, as major mechanisms underlying resistance to EGFR-targeted therapy in HNSCC. We focus particularly on the ERK signaling pathway as a central integrator of genetic, epigenetic, and adaptive resistance mechanisms. Sustained ERK activity restores downstream EGFR outputs, promotes feedback ligand production, drives epithelial-mesenchymal transition and cellular plasticity, and engages parallel oncogenic pathways, thereby enabling tumor cells to evade cetuximab-mediated EGFR blockade. Combined targeting of ERK and EGFR may therefore represent a promising strategy for overcoming cetuximab resistance in selected molecular contexts.
abstract_zh: 头颈鳞状细胞癌(HNSCC)是全球第六大常见癌症。主要危险因素包括吸烟、过量饮酒和感染致癌 人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV)。尽管 治疗 取得了进展,但 HNSCC 仍然与不良预后相关,特别是对于患有晚期或复发/转移性疾病的患者。表皮生长因子受体 (EGFR) 已被认为是 HNSCC 的关键致癌驱动因素,因为它经常过度表达并促进多种促肿瘤信号通路的激活,包括 ERK 和 PI3K/Akt。西妥昔单抗仍然是唯一被批准针对 HNSCC 肿瘤相关受体的分子靶向药物。然而,其临床益处受到低反应率和频繁产生耐药性的限制,即使在最初有反应的肿瘤中也是如此。因此,了解 EGFR 靶向治疗耐药的分子基础对于开发更有效的药理学策略和提高西妥昔单抗的临床应用至关重要。在这篇综述中,我们总结了 EGFR 改变、平行补偿途径的激活以及下游信号级联(包括 PI3K/Akt 和 Ras/ERK)的重新激活,作为 HNSCC EGFR 靶向治疗耐药的主要机制。我们特别关注 ERK 信号通路作为遗传、表观遗传和适应性抵抗机制的中心整合器。持续的 ERK 活性恢复下游 EGFR 输出,促进反馈配体产生,驱动上皮间质转化和细胞可塑性,并参与平行的致癌途径,从而使肿瘤细胞能够逃避西妥昔单抗介导的 EGFR 阻断。因此,ERK 和 EGFR 的联合靶向可能代表了在选定的分子背景下克服西妥昔单抗耐药性的有前途的策略。

title: POST-TREATMENT SURVEILLANCE AND MANAGEMENT OF RECURRENT CERVICAL CANCER - A REVIEW FROM THE FRENCH CERVICAL CANCER GUIDELINES GROUP.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To review the available evidence on post-treatment follow-up and recurrence management after cervical cancer. METHODS: We conducted a narrative review of the literature on surveillance modalities, and the management of pelvic and nodal recurrences. RESULTS: Most recurrences occur within three years of treatment, but the survival benefit of detection before symptom onset remains unproven. After fertility-sparing surgery, HPV testing is sensitive for detecting asymptomatic pelvic recurrence. After hysterectomy, most recurrences are symptomatic, and clinical examination has a higher diagnostic yield than HPV testing or vaginal vault cytology. After concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CRT), persistent HPV infection is associated with an increased recurrence risk, but its limited specificity and the absence of a validated HPV-based surveillance strategy restrict its clinical utility. MRI and FDG PET/CT are useful for response assessment and investigation of suspected recurrence, but evidence supporting routine imaging of asymptomatic patients is lacking. Intensive follow-up schedules have not improved recurrence detection or survival. Evidence on recurrence management is predominantly retrospective. Pelvic recurrences after primary surgery have been treated with CRT, supplemented by brachytherapy for vaginal involvement. In selected patients with central pelvic recurrence after CRT, complete surgical resection may provide prolonged survival, but carries substantial morbidity. Nodal recurrences outside previously irradiated fields have been treated with CRT. CONCLUSION: Available evidence supports a predominantly clinical, treatment-adapted follow-up. The survival benefit of intensive surveillance, routine imaging, or detecting asymptomatic recurrence remains uncertain. Recurrence management requires individualized multidisciplinary assessment based on disease extent, disease-free interval, and previous treatments.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review aims to evaluate post-treatment follow-up and recurrence management strategies for cervical cancer, focusing on the role of human papillomaviruses (HPV) in recurrence detection and treatment.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of the literature on surveillance methods and recurrence management, with an emphasis on HPV testing and imaging techniques. It includes evidence on the timing of recurrences, the utility of HPV testing in different treatment contexts, and the role of imaging modalities.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The evidence suggests that most cervical cancer recurrences occur within three years of treatment, but the survival benefit of early detection remains unproven. Clinical examination is more effective than HPV testing or vaginal vault cytology in detecting recurrences after hysterectomy, while HPV testing is sensitive for asymptomatic pelvic recurrence following fertility-sparing surgery. Persistent HPV infection is linked to increased recurrence risk after CRT, but its clinical utility is limited due to low specificity and lack of a validated strategy.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is uncertainty regarding the survival benefit of intensive surveillance or routine imaging in asymptomatic patients. The evidence is largely retrospective, and there is a lack of robust data supporting the routine use of imaging for asymptomatic individuals. Additionally, the role of HPV in recurrence management after CRT is not fully established due to limited specificity and absence of a validated strategy.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to determine the clinical utility of HPV-based surveillance strategies and to validate the effectiveness of imaging modalities in asymptomatic patients. Practice should focus on individualized, multidisciplinary approaches for recurrence management, considering disease extent, disease-free interval, and prior treatments.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates post-treatment surveillance and management of recurrent cervical cancer, emphasizing the role of human papillomaviruses (HPV) in recurrence detection. It highlights that most recurrences occur within three years of treatment, but the survival benefit of early detection remains unproven. HPV testing is effective for asymptomatic pelvic recurrence after fertility-sparing surgery, while clinical examination is more sensitive for detecting recurrences after hysterectomy. Persistent HPV infection is associated with higher recurrence risk after concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CRT), but its clinical utility is limited due to low specificity and lack of a validated strategy. The review underscores the need for individualized, multidisciplinary approaches in managing recurrences and calls for further research to clarify the role of HPV-based surveillance and imaging in asymptomatic patients.

elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 证据表明,大多数 宫颈癌 复发发生在 治疗 的三年内,但早期检测的生存益处尚未得到证实。在检测子宫切除术后的复发方面,临床检查比 HPV 检测或阴道穹窿细胞学检查更有效,而 HPV 检测对保留生育手术后的无症状盆腔复发敏感。持续的 HPV 感染与 CRT 后复发风险增加有关,但由于特异性低且缺乏经过验证的策略,其临床实用性受到限制。

analysis_en.scope_and_question: The review aims to evaluate post-treatment follow-up and recurrence management strategies for cervical cancer, focusing on the role of human papillomaviruses (HPV) in recurrence detection and treatment.
analysis_en.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of the literature on surveillance methods and recurrence management, with an emphasis on HPV testing and imaging techniques. It includes evidence on the timing of recurrences, the utility of HPV testing in different treatment contexts, and the role of imaging modalities.
analysis_en.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The evidence suggests that most cervical cancer recurrences occur within three years of treatment, but the survival benefit of early detection remains unproven. Clinical examination is more effective than HPV testing or vaginal vault cytology in detecting recurrences after hysterectomy, while HPV testing is sensitive for asymptomatic pelvic recurrence following fertility-sparing surgery. Persistent HPV infection is linked to increased recurrence risk after CRT, but its clinical utility is limited due to low specificity and lack of a validated strategy.
analysis_en.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is uncertainty regarding the survival benefit of intensive surveillance or routine imaging in asymptomatic patients. The evidence is largely retrospective, and there is a lack of robust data supporting the routine use of imaging for asymptomatic individuals. Additionally, the role of HPV in recurrence management after CRT is not fully established due to limited specificity and absence of a validated strategy.
analysis_en.research_and_practice_implications: Further research is needed to determine the clinical utility of HPV-based surveillance strategies and to validate the effectiveness of imaging modalities in asymptomatic patients. Practice should focus on individualized, multidisciplinary approaches for recurrence management, considering disease extent, disease-free interval, and prior treatments.

title_zh: 治疗 后 监测 和经常性 宫颈癌 的管理 - 法国 宫颈癌 指南小组的审查。
source_body_en: OBJECTIVE: To review the available evidence on post-treatment follow-up and recurrence management after cervical cancer. METHODS: We conducted a narrative review of the literature on surveillance modalities, and the management of pelvic and nodal recurrences. RESULTS: Most recurrences occur within three years of treatment, but the survival benefit of detection before symptom onset remains unproven. After fertility-sparing surgery, HPV testing is sensitive for detecting asymptomatic pelvic recurrence. After hysterectomy, most recurrences are symptomatic, and clinical examination has a higher diagnostic yield than HPV testing or vaginal vault cytology. After concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CRT), persistent HPV infection is associated with an increased recurrence risk, but its limited specificity and the absence of a validated HPV-based surveillance strategy restrict its clinical utility. MRI and FDG PET/CT are useful for response assessment and investigation of suspected recurrence, but evidence supporting routine imaging of asymptomatic patients is lacking. Intensive follow-up schedules have not improved recurrence detection or survival. Evidence on recurrence management is predominantly retrospective. Pelvic recurrences after primary surgery have been treated with CRT, supplemented by brachytherapy for vaginal involvement. In selected patients with central pelvic recurrence after CRT, complete surgical resection may provide prolonged survival, but carries substantial morbidity. Nodal recurrences outside previously irradiated fields have been treated with CRT. CONCLUSION: Available evidence supports a predominantly clinical, treatment-adapted follow-up. The survival benefit of intensive surveillance, routine imaging, or detecting asymptomatic recurrence remains uncertain. Recurrence management requires individualized multidisciplinary assessment based on disease extent, disease-free interval, and previous treatments.
abstract_zh: 目的:回顾 治疗 后随访和 宫颈癌 后复发管理的现有证据。方法:我们对 监测 模式以及盆腔和淋巴结复发治疗的文献进行了叙述性回顾。结果:大多数复发发生在 治疗 治疗后三年内,但症状出现前检测的生存益处尚未得到证实。保留生育能力手术后,HPV 检测对于检测无症状盆腔复发非常敏感。子宫切除术后,大多数复发都是有症状的,临床检查比 HPV 检测或阴道穹窿细胞学检查具有更高的诊断率。同步放化疗(CRT)后,持续性 HPV 感染与复发风险增加相关,但其特异性有限且缺乏基于 HPV 的经过验证的 监测 策略限制了其临床应用。MRI 和 FDG PET/CT 可用于疗效评估和疑似复发调查,但缺乏支持无症状患者常规影像学检查的证据。密集的随访计划并没有改善复发检测或生存率。关于复发管理的证据主要是回顾性的。初次手术后盆腔复发可采用 CRT 治疗,并辅以近距离放射治疗治疗阴道受累。在 CRT 后出现中央盆腔复发的特定患者中,完全手术切除可能会延长生存期,但会带来较高的发病率。先前照射区域外的淋巴结复发已采用 CRT 进行治疗。结论:现有证据支持主要临床、治疗 适应的随访。强化 监测、常规成像或检测无症状复发的生存获益仍不确定。复发管理需要根据疾病程度、无病间隔和既往 治疗 进行个体化多学科评估。

title: Advanced Anal Squamous Cell Carcinoma in the Chemoimmunotherapy Era: Retifanlimab, Nivolumab, and a Practical Framework for Treatment Selection.
abstract: Advanced anal squamous cell carcinoma (ASCC) is a rare human papillomavirus-associated malignancy with historically limited prospective evidence for systemic therapy. InterAAct established carboplatin-paclitaxel as a clinically favorable chemotherapy backbone compared with cisplatin-fluorouracil. POD1UM-303/InterAACT-2 subsequently showed that adding retifanlimab significantly improved progression-free survival in patients with no prior systemic therapy for advanced disease. At the final overall-survival analysis, median overall survival was 32.8 versus 22.2 months (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.55-1.01); the regimen has received regulatory authorization in the United States, the European Union, and Japan. EA2176 is evaluating carboplatin-paclitaxel with or without nivolumab and will clarify whether first-line PD-1-based chemoimmunotherapy represents a reproducible class effect. This focused narrative review critically summarizes the evidence for retifanlimab- and nivolumab-based strategies and proposes a practical framework for treatment selection. Key considerations include performance status, immune-checkpoint-inhibitor eligibility, HIV infection, autoimmune risk, neuropathy, organ function, tumor burden, local symptom control, and post-chemoimmunotherapy sequencing. Retifanlimab plus carboplatin-paclitaxel currently has the most mature phase III evidence, whereas nivolumab-based chemoimmunotherapy remains investigational pending EA2176. Treatment decisions should distinguish phase III-validated options from class-effect extrapolation and integrate multidisciplinary local therapy when appropriate.

The evidence highlights that carboplatin-paclitaxel is a favorable chemotherapy backbone, and adding retifanlimab improves progression-free survival in patients without prior systemic therapy. At the final overall-survival analysis, median overall survival was 32.8 versus 22.2 months (HR 0.75, 95% CI 0.55-1.01); the regimen has received regulatory authorization in the United States, the European Union, and Japan. EA2176 is evaluating carboplatin-paclitaxel with or without nivolumab and will clarify whether first-line PD-1-based chemoimmunotherapy represents a reproducible class effect. This focused narrative review critically summarizes the evidence for retifanlimab- and nivolumab-based strategies and proposes a practical framework for treatment selection. Key considerations include performance status, immune-checkpoint-inhibitor eligibility, HIV infection, autoimmune risk, neuropathy, organ function, tumor burden, local symptom control, and post-chemoimmunotherapy sequencing. Retifanlimab plus carboplatin-paclitaxel currently has the most mature phase III evidence, whereas nivolumab-based chemoimmunotherapy remains investigational pending EA2176. Treatment decisions should distinguish phase III-validated options from class-effect extrapolation and integrate multidisciplinary local therapy when appropriate.

title: From HPV Genetic Diversity to Precision Therapeutics: Viral-Host Interactions and Emerging Strategies for Cervical Cancer Prevention and Treatment
abstract: Cervical cancer is a major global health challenge, especially in low- and middle-income countries, despite the availability of effective prophylactic human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines, screening methods and established treatments. Cervical cancer is primarily caused by persistent infection with high-risk HPV, but persistent infection is necessary, but not sufficient, for the development of cancer. Advances in understanding HPV genetic diversity, viral persistence, and virus-host molecular interactions are creating new opportunities to improve precision in HPV prevention and treatment. HPV genotype distribution and differences in oncogenic potential inform vaccine development and screening strategies. The viral oncoproteins E6 and E7 disrupt host tumor-suppressor pathways, driving cellular immortalization and genomic instability. Molecular events such as viral insertion, epigenetic modifications, APOBEC-associated mutations, and immune escape contribute to disease progression. These discoveries have revealed molecular vulnerabilities that can be targeted therapeutically. Immune checkpoint inhibitors and antibody-drug conjugates are used clinically in specific contexts of cervical cancer presentation and treatment. At the same time, therapeutic vaccines, adoptive cellular immunotherapies, RNA interference, and genome editing are being investigated as complementary strategies to target HPV-associated cervical cancer. With advances in next-generation sequencing, molecular biomarkers, and artificial intelligence, these tools could further refine risk stratification and therapy selection. This review explores the current understanding of HPV genetic variation and virus-host interactions driving a shift from traditional prevention and treatment strategies to precision prevention and targeted therapeutics, and critically assesses remaining challenges.
